about_short_description.short_description: Moglix is an online marketplace for business supplies and industrial equipment.

product.name: Industrial Tools and Equipment
product.description: Industrial and construction tools for drilling, grinding, cutting, demolition, welding, material handling, measurement, and general maintenance.

product.name: Electrical Products and Equipment
product.description: Electrical supplies including wires, cables, batteries, circuit protection, switches, distribution equipment, power backup, generators, transformers, and solar inverters.

identifier.value: Safety Supplies and Personal Protective Equipment

product.name: Safety Supplies and Personal Protective Equipment
product.description: Workplace safety products such as safety shoes, helmets, gloves, workwear, respirators, harnesses, fire extinguishers, lockout/tagout kits, and traffic-safety equipment.

product.name: Agriculture and Farming Equipment
product.description: Agricultural machinery and inputs including milking machines, sprayers, pumps, brush cutters, chainsaws, tillers, seeders, fertilizers, pesticides, and seeds.

product.name: Medical, Hospital, and Laboratory Supplies
product.description: Healthcare equipment and consumables including glucometers, glucose sensors and strips, blood-pressure monitors, medical beds, examination tables, orthopedic supports, nebulization kits, and dressings.

product.name: Office Stationery and Business Equipment
product.description: Office products including printers, toner and ink cartridges, paper, lamination pouches, sticker paper, calculators, punches, speakers, currency-counting machines, barcode scanners, and office furniture.
